data.body: **P2: Preserve admission when draining is interrupted.** If either task wait throws on interruption, this `finally` closes admission while operations are still running. A blocked step released afterward has its `SUCCEED` checkpoint—and fallback `FAIL` checkpoint—rejected. The caller's subsequent `close()` cannot reopen admission, so retry can repeat work that the base implementation would have checkpointed. Leave the lifecycle `DRAINING` when draining fails, and transition to `CLOSED` only after remaining tasks exit. Extend the interruption regression to verify that the late step result is checkpointed and reused on replay.
